parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceAttribute](~~62010~~) operation to query the region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The details of the tags bound to the instance.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to **INSTANCE**.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that are attached to the resources.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-group-id rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000 --resource-id dds-bp1fa5efaa930000 --tag Value=4.0_environment Key=Development_group --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'dds-bp1fa5efaa930000' --Tag.1.Key Development_group --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000' --Tag.1.Value '4.0_environment' --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
